title: Original C550 Bench inputs require explicit INT64 and BOOL storage

evidence.scope: Original ABI audit and exact frozen C1 vocabulary. No failed GPU Run or device support is inferred.

observation: C1 DType, WorkloadContract.tensor_abi, TensorLaunchManifest and MACA launch dtype maps do not admit these original input types. NativeTritonEnvironment uses the same closed ABI. Casting inputs in a Torch wrapper would change the route and must not stand in for pure Cake support.
proposed_change: Add explicit discrete storage, bounded indexing, matching comparisons, typed select, exact BOOL-to-INT32/FP32 and INT32-to-INT64 casts, and RNE INT64-to-FP32. Refuse INT64 narrowing and automatic BOOL arithmetic. Keep typing, byte counts, Triton emission, manifest, storage snapshots and MACA argument checks consistent.
promotion_disposition: Shared software implementation only. Device capacity remains open until independent native compilation and device campaigns qualify generated INT64/BOOL operations; existing Runs retain C1. No performance claim.

software_verification.tests: 194 contract tests: 192 passed, 1 skipped without CPU Torch, 1 existing native_triton_pairing custody setup failed with macOS EPERM. The run stopped; permissions were not changed and no retry repaired the environment.
software_verification.scope: CPU typed source model, real parser/verifier/emission, metadata and driver contract fixtures only. Native compilation, GPU correctness and timing remain unverified.
